lines.text: The LORD commanded Moses to make a covenant in Moab, in addition to the covenant made at Horeb.
For forty years in the wilderness, Israel's clothes and sandals did not wear out, and they ate no bread.
Israel defeated Sihon king of Heshbon and Og king of Bashan, and gave their land to the Reubenites, the Gadites, and half of Manasseh.
The LORD would establish them as His people, as He swore to Abraham, Isaac, and Jacob.
The whole land would become a burning waste of sulfur and salt, like the destruction of Sodom and Gomorrah.
